nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel entry point for the i18n module that re-exports the TranslationKey type, defines supported locales, and provides the core translate() function with fallback chain and parameter interpolation.

nodes.name: translate
nodes.summary: Translates a key by looking up the string in the target locale dictionary, falling back to English and then the raw key, with support for parameter interpolation via {param} placeholders.

nodes.name: en.ts
nodes.summary: English translation dictionary serving as the source of truth for all translation keys. Defines 1500+ keys across navigation, chat, settings, extensions, MCP, buddy, and other UI sections. Exports the TranslationKey type derived from its keys.

nodes.name: zh.ts
nodes.summary: Chinese (Simplified) translation dictionary implementing Record<TranslationKey, string> with localized strings for all keys defined in the English source file.
